rounds.notes:
**power notes:** [Crepuscular Circle](item_c0b93ed2-b692-44d5-a38a-ce5a63e83cdb) is non-negotiable for first round, and it's pretty much the only power that absolutely MUST be chosen.

**item notes:**  [Weapon Grease](item_961ae72f-434f-406b-a89b-ab8efec806bf) and  [Compensator](item_2a354f80-610c-4661-9bdd-8960ae1a60b0) are your main picks and any of the optional items are good options - just pick based on your playstyle.

- i like  [Winning Attitude](item_8714087c-c078-4619-a2ef-327bc6edaa69) because you never know how first round will go. if i don't die much and I have the creds next round, i'll swap it to one of the other optional items depending on what i think i'd get the most value from.

**strategy notes:** you're basically playing vanilla mercy UNTIL you get ult. 

- you DO NOT need to save ult for a genji ult or a low tank. i typically pop ult the second i get it because it builds back up so fast - i only hold on to it if we're already in an obviously losing (or obviously winning) fight and wouldn't get value. as long as you have 3ish teammates around you to benefit from the passive beams in ult, slam Q and pull the blaster out

- please do NOT fly around with your staff out in ult. it's my biggest pet peeve. your beams attach WITH OR WITHOUT your staff out. so if you're not at least being annoying with your blaster shots, you're just wasting a power slot imo.

**power notes:** n/a

**item notes:** there's really no purple item that's useful enough to sell everything for atp. i like  [Icy Coolant](item_8b1c21e9-33e8-49a6-8277-a3a06d55a65f) +  [Advanced Nanobiotics](item_26fcf7c9-b81a-4d8e-a459-b515519cb73e) and i usually have the creds for them both.

**strategy notes:** no big changes from last round. 

- keep an eye on your other support's build to see if you need to change up your gameplay (ie you typically need to healbot if you have an early-game zen or a clone build kiri, you typically can get away with leaving your tank half dead to dmg boost a dps if you have a good moira, etc)

- keep an eye on the scariest dps build (typically an ashe or an annoying soldier) and the builds of any of the counters i have listed (ana, jq). a nade/cd build ana or a jq that is building ults fast is going to mess UP your healing capabilities and you will need to play more defensively/keep track of cds

**side notes:** mathematically speaking for mercy, you can pretty much just stack her weapon and attack speed on top of each other in your head as "heal power". 100% weapon power heals a teammate to full in the exact same time as 100% attack speed (i timed it).

- this means that (most of the time)  [Advanced Nanobiotics](item_26fcf7c9-b81a-4d8e-a459-b515519cb73e) gives you the same healing boost as  [Talon Modification Module](item_c0ca1795-a3ea-4dc9-ae17-f34122574b3a) and costs 2k less creds that you could be using on additional green items.

- you want to max out your item SLOTS rather than your creds in the first couple rounds especially. it's almost always better for your stats. only splurge on the higher tier items when you run out of slots or when you need the special buff (like rez range, cd reduction, etc)

**it's choose your own adventure time!!!** 

i put my usual build items in the "buy" slots, but ignore if you don't wanna follow that particular power progression

items depend on power choice - notes on how to choose powers + what alternative items to get below. fill in any extra slots with greens and blues :)

-  [Renaissance](item_a460f234-6434-4d47-99f9-d4a0b15cd591) my typical round 3 choice. in any average game, this is what i get. it's the most fun for me as well.  [Resurrection Rangefinder](item_99baffec-51b5-42e4-be61-e29f3de8219f) becomes non-negotiable here

-  [Triage Unit](item_fec0554c-2685-4b93-822d-bf0020e654b4) if your team is hurting for heals and you don't think a sneaky rez will save your teamfights, get triage unit. get  [Angelic Acrobatics](item_baad85fc-3da5-43af-ad9d-f17885f59aa5) and any cd items that feel useful. your GA cd will be 1 second which means anyone that's low has a constant 30% heal buff

-  [Serenity](item_c6e1c072-ff50-467e-b59f-9506baea10c1) grab this if YOU are the one hurting for heals. build up weapon power and survival items -  [Angelic Acrobatics](item_baad85fc-3da5-43af-ad9d-f17885f59aa5) +  [Ironclad Exhaust Ports](item_2d085fa5-ace6-4fab-9323-b7a06268bcd0) goes hard as a survival combo

-  [Distortion](item_5557e2f2-02df-4eac-8128-0c23b71183b1) or  [Battle Medic](item_ccd0edff-4d57-4ac2-83a7-bab6ff0ffb2f) either is a good option for when you're ROLLING enemy team and just want some fun rounds. distortion means you can ignore your team even more during ult and battle medic means you can be a flying machine gun of death. max out your weapon power and attack speed for maximum ult kills :]

item notes divided up by power choice again

-  [Renaissance](item_a460f234-6434-4d47-99f9-d4a0b15cd591) grab  [Booster Jets](item_a291de85-b6d9-43cf-b5da-f3184a156f48) if you can afford or just max out your weapon power/attack speed

-  [Triage Unit](item_fec0554c-2685-4b93-822d-bf0020e654b4) get [Hardlight Accelerator](item_0390c8af-2a68-4da2-b876-93da32c3f448). this combo with  [Angelic Acrobatics](item_baad85fc-3da5-43af-ad9d-f17885f59aa5) gives you 25% weapon power + 10% general cd + 1 sec GA cd pretty much at all times. if you can get those stats/better than those stats with other blue/green items, do that instead

-  [Serenity](item_c6e1c072-ff50-467e-b59f-9506baea10c1) this one is more flexible. did you die much last round? if yes, then stack more survival items. if no, stack more weapon power/attack speed for bigger heal number

-  [Distortion](item_5557e2f2-02df-4eac-8128-0c23b71183b1) +  [Battle Medic](item_ccd0edff-4d57-4ac2-83a7-bab6ff0ffb2f) machine gun build goes crazy. attack speed, attack speed, attack speed!!!!!

if you didn't get  [Renaissance](item_a460f234-6434-4d47-99f9-d4a0b15cd591) in round 3, i would definitely recommend getting it here.

otherwise use **round 3 notes** to decide which power is best for you this round and follow item notes below

**power notes:** i typically get  [Triage Unit](item_fec0554c-2685-4b93-822d-bf0020e654b4) here, but if you're getting like 4-6 rezzes in a round and they're a liiiiittle too close for comfort,  [First Responder](item_30a5c70f-e0b5-489a-96ae-900f34c3823d) is a good option. do NOT choose first responder before getting renaissance - it's just not worth imo

- if you got  [Renaissance](item_a460f234-6434-4d47-99f9-d4a0b15cd591) last round and your team is doing fine on heals, you could go for  [Distortion](item_5557e2f2-02df-4eac-8128-0c23b71183b1) or  [Battle Medic](item_ccd0edff-4d57-4ac2-83a7-bab6ff0ffb2f). try and grab cd reduction items to max out your rez/valk uptime

**item notes:** the core items for all of these builds is  [Resurrection Rangefinder](item_99baffec-51b5-42e4-be61-e29f3de8219f) +  [Angelic Acrobatics](item_baad85fc-3da5-43af-ad9d-f17885f59aa5).  [Hardlight Accelerator](item_0390c8af-2a68-4da2-b876-93da32c3f448) and  [Ironclad Exhaust Ports](item_2d085fa5-ace6-4fab-9323-b7a06268bcd0) have insane synergy with all build options as well, but they're more secondary to the resurrection range and GA cd.

- as usual, grab the recommended items and then fill in your remaining item slots with blues/greens to max out weapon power, attack speed, or survival

**power notes:** n/a

**item notes:** here's where you finally swap out [Advanced Nanobiotics](item_26fcf7c9-b81a-4d8e-a459-b515519cb73e). grab  [Talon Modification Module](item_c0ca1795-a3ea-4dc9-ae17-f34122574b3a) if you're hurting for creds, or  [Booster Jets](item_a291de85-b6d9-43cf-b5da-f3184a156f48) if you have enough.

- swap  [Icy Coolant](item_8b1c21e9-33e8-49a6-8277-a3a06d55a65f) with  [Amari's Antidote](item_67e0b1c5-3bcb-4ab5-b818-5082e5706124) if you have the creds and don't need extra survival.  [Mark of the Kitsune](item_09a53e39-25aa-4f66-ba51-bedbc543a1eb) is also a good option to swap to here

- you can swap [Ironclad Exhaust Ports](item_2d085fa5-ace6-4fab-9323-b7a06268bcd0) or  [Icy Coolant](item_8b1c21e9-33e8-49a6-8277-a3a06d55a65f) with  [Martian Mender](item_0099632b-4e18-450e-844f-22c40e51bc98) if you need higher survival. *also leave a comment about if you prefer martian mender - i don't frequently go for survival so i'm not sure if the martian mender success was just random chance*

**the final choice in your adventure!!!!**

**power notes:** i usually go  [Distortion](item_5557e2f2-02df-4eac-8128-0c23b71183b1) (it's the most flexible option) but it's literally easier to tell you which options are Bad (generally) in this round than it is to tell you which option is Best.

**GOOD options:**

-  [Battle Medic](item_ccd0edff-4d57-4ac2-83a7-bab6ff0ffb2f) very fun! zen hates you, ana hates you, jq hates you (shes relatively squishy unless lifesteal build), soldier hates you, ashe hates you, reaper hates you, everybody hates you because you shred them

-  [Triage Unit](item_fec0554c-2685-4b93-822d-bf0020e654b4) if you didn't choose this earlier and team needs more heals, probably the best option for this round"

-   [First Responder](item_30a5c70f-e0b5-489a-96ae-900f34c3823d) you still have to actually *get* the rez, but assuming you do, you'll get free ult for 5 seconds (that's enough time to kill like 1-2 squishies EASY)

-  [Serenity](item_c6e1c072-ff50-467e-b59f-9506baea10c1) your heals are so strong atp that you basically just outheal anything that isn't burst damage (eg: good against visor soldier, bad against homing helix rocket soldier)

-  [Glass Extra Full](item_659ff350-8602-42cd-b5f9-f4da7e5e912b) another very flexible option. kinda nice against anti because your team has a couple extra points of health to help them survive until you can heal them again.

-  [Threads of Fate](item_cb61612b-9d83-49a9-989d-013bf084fbcb) im a threads of fate hater but your beam is so strong by now that it can actually be significantly influential in a teamfight.

-  [Protective Beam](item_3f1ef995-8ecc-45fb-8b57-26fdccc21feb) another flexible pick. i'm not a fan because i think other power options offer greater value, but if you have a lot of valk uptime, any of your teammates above 80% health will be happy

**BAD options:**

-  [The Whambulance](item_67e91029-d0fc-4c9d-9733-ec7e1cc064a9) i want to see a ability power build that is actually viable but i haven't yet. regardless, this would be a throw pick specifically with this particular build. even though the  [Hardlight Accelerator](item_0390c8af-2a68-4da2-b876-93da32c3f448) +  [Angelic Acrobatics](item_baad85fc-3da5-43af-ad9d-f17885f59aa5) has good synergy, there's no ability power to buff the heals that come out of it and i wouldn't recommend sacrificing weapon power to get it in this build.

-  [Equivalent Exchange](item_82826007-bdfd-4bba-a04a-2f67e6eb7169) the main goal of this build involves getting as many rezzes as possible. POSSIBLY a fine pick depending on map, but why would you limit the number of rezzes AND the amount of extra valk uptime?

**item notes:** you pretty much just upgrade your blue items to purple items with better stats and that's it. i like  [Mark of the Kitsune](item_09a53e39-25aa-4f66-ba51-bedbc543a1eb) or  [Weapon Jammer](item_72386db6-753e-413d-aa2a-f1389842f47f) best but there are some good survival items out there as well
